alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:9eb05eb7-7.title: Revenue Accounting Manager
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:9eb05eb7-7.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We're looking for a Revenue Accounting Manager to own billing, contract review, and revenue recognition as Baseten scales. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who wants full ownership of the revenue cycle at a company where deal structures are getting more complex: usage-based pricing, committed capacity, credits, multi-year enterprise contracts, and new business models coming online. You'll join Lauren, who built Baseten's quote-to-cash function from the ground up, to take on billing, contract review, and revenue recognition as deal volume and complexity grow. Having completed our first year-end audit, we're now focused on tightening contract review processes, close procedures, and reporting rigor to support the scale ahead. You'll partner closely with Lauren, FP&A, Sales, Legal, and Revenue Operations to make sure every deal is structured, billed, and recognized correctly from day one. Baseten is building the infrastructure layer for AI-native companies, and we're scaling quickly - in deal volume, contract complexity, and customer size. If you want real ownership over a growing function on a lean team, this role offers real scope. RESPONSIBILITIES Revenue Recognition and Technical Accounting - Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 across all contract types, including usage-based/consumption arrangements, committed capacity deals, credits, multi-year contracts, and new business models - Serve as the go-to person on rev rec treatment for new deal structures, products, and pricing models Billing Operations - Own end-to-end billing: invoice generation, accuracy checks, and dispute resolution - Identify and automate manual, error-prone steps in the billing-to-cash workflow - Assist with strengthening our collections efforts and overall process Contract Review and Deal Support - Build and maintain a standardized contract review process for Sales and Legal, flagging non-standard terms that affect recognition before deals close - Partner directly with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Legal as a proactive advisor on deal structuring Sales and Indirect Tax - Own the sales and indirect tax process, including reviewing and maintaining our tax automation tool (nexus tracking, exemption certificates, filings), and building the governance around it as we scale into new jurisdictions Close and Reporting - Own the revenue-related monthly close: deferred revenue rollforward, unbilled AR, credit memos, and revenue reserves - Partner with FP&A to reconcile billed vs. recognized revenue and support ARR reporting and forecasting - Own revenue-related audit deliverables, including technical memos and sample testing support REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3+ years focused specifically on revenue accounting and recognition - Deep working knowledge of ASC 606, including variable consideration, multiple performance obligations, and usage-based revenue models - Hands-on experience reviewing and abstracting commercial contracts for accounting treatment - Experience owning billing operations directly, not just reviewing output from a billing team - Public company or audit-ready private company experience (Big 4 or industry, with audit exposure) - Builder mentality with a bias toward execution; comfortable operating on a lean team relative to company scale - Our five online stores—Backcountry, Level Nine Sports, Competitive Cyclist, MotoSport, and SteepandCheap—aim to supply our customers with the gear, knowledge, and inspiration necessary to get out there and chase down life’s greatest moments. We do this by providing the biggest and best assortment of premium outdoor products, a superior shopping experience, personalized Gearhead expertise, lightning-fast and accurate fulfillment, and inspirational, informative, and community-centered content. The ideal candidate should have a passion for outdoor activities and possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills. We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Seasonal Retail Gearhead (Sales Associate) to join our retail team for the holiday season (expected employment from November through February). The successful candidate will be responsible for providing exceptional customer service, generating sales, and helping customers find the right outdoor gear and apparel for their needs. cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:843.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in culinary techniques, cooking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Savory plays a key role in inspiring a love for cooking while driving sales of cookware, cutlery, and kitchen tools through hands-on savory classes and engaging culinary instruction. jobgether-jobgether:lever:91b8b8ce-f2a2-.title: Proposal Technical Writer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:91b8b8ce-f2a2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Proposal Technical Writer based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to shape high-quality proposals that support government and commercial business opportunities. You will transform complex technical information into clear, persuasive, and evaluation-focused content. Working closely with subject matter experts and project teams, you will ensure proposals are accurate, compelling, and compliant. Your research and writing will help communicate technical capabilities and address client priorities effectively. The role requires strong ownership, organization, and attention to detail in a deadline-driven environment. As part of a remote team, you will contribute to a collaborative proposal process where quality and consistency are essential. Some travel may be required depending on business needs. Develop clear, compelling, and technically accurate proposals in response to government and commercial solicitations, ensuring content addresses client requirements and evaluation criteria. Translate complex technical concepts, processes, and capabilities into concise, accessible, and reader-focused proposal content. Collaborate with subject matter experts, project managers, and cross-functional teams to gather information, validate technical details, and develop strong responses. Research industry trends, customer needs, competitive offerings, and relevant market information to strengthen proposal strategy and positioning. Edit and proofread proposal materials for grammar, clarity, consistency, formatting, compliance, and professional tone. Maintain organized repositories of proposal content, templates, past submissions, and reusable materials to support future proposal development. Manage multiple writing assignments and proposal deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality and accuracy. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Technical Writing, English, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. At least 5 years of experience in technical writing or proposal development, preferably within the government contracting sector. Demonstrated ability to understand and communicate complex technical information clearly and effectively. Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, and content-structuring skills with strong attention to detail. Strong research and analytical abilities, including the capacity to gather, evaluate, and synthesize information from multiple sources. Familiarity with government contracting proposals, solicitations, compliance requirements, and evaluation criteria is highly valuable. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with proposal management or collaboration tools. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical experts and non-technical stakeholders. A proactive, adaptable approach and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. Benefits: Full-time, remote position within the United States. Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications. Opportunities to work on government and commercial proposals with meaningful business impact. Collaborative environment with exposure to technical experts, project managers, and diverse subject areas. Opportunities for professional development and continued growth in proposal development and technical writing. Some travel may be required depending on project and business needs. Benefits and additional employment offerings may be provided according to the position and applicable company policies. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a10ae038-0f86-.title: Azure Data Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a10ae038-0f86-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer based in Turkey. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen cybersecurity operations by engineering reliable, scalable security data pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work with high volumes of security telemetry and help ensure critical data is available for threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility. The position combines hands-on data engineering with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, automation, and data quality management. You’ll collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, governance, and vendor teams to onboard and optimize diverse data sources. The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting complex ingestion challenges and improving system reliability and efficiency. You’ll operate in a highly regulated financial services environment where data integrity, security, and operational excellence are essential. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats. Design, build, and maintain scalable security data ingestion pipelines for SIEM and cloud data platforms, including Azure Data Explorer and Log Analytics. Parse, normalize, transform, enrich, and validate structured and unstructured security telemetry using regex, JSON parsing, schema mapping, and other data-processing techniques. Partner with application owners, infrastructure and cloud teams, vendors, security stakeholders, and other internal groups to onboard new log sources and validate end-to-end data flows. Ensure the integrity, completeness, timeliness, and quality of security telemetry used for monitoring, detection, incident response, reporting, and risk management. Align security data with established schemas, naming conventions, governance standards, and organizational requirements to support downstream analytics and automation. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, transformation, schema, and data-quality issues across diverse platforms and environments. Maintain clear documentation covering log onboarding procedures, source requirements, data mappings, pipeline configurations, and operational support processes. Collaborate with detection engineering and security operations teams to ensure telemetry supports investigation, threat detection, response, and cyber risk use cases. Conduct telemetry gap analyses, identify missing or incomplete data sources, and recommend priorities for improving security coverage. Support logging practices that meet regulatory, audit, compliance, retention, and data-integrity requirements. Improve ingestion frameworks, automation, and onboarding processes to increase scalability, repeatability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Support infrastructure-as-code, scripting, and automation initiatives that streamline deployment and ongoing pipeline maintenance. Monitor pipeline performance and work with stakeholders to optimize ingestion reliability, throughput, and operational costs. Stay current with emerging cybersecurity telemetry formats, logging standards, data engineering practices, and cloud security data-platform capabilities. Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, data engineering, log management, security operations, or a related technology discipline. Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments. Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data. Familiarity with security telemetry from network, endpoint, identity, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bcb3eb14-515d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Render Artist - Driving Empire based in Canada. Join a global, fully remote art team creating visual experiences for a major Roblox automotive game. You’ll produce high-quality renders for both in-game experiences and marketing campaigns, helping shape how players discover and engage with the game. The role combines technical 3D skills with strong creative instincts, visual storytelling, and an understanding of Roblox culture. You’ll collaborate closely with the Art Lead to develop concepts, refine assets, and maintain a consistent visual identity. Your work will respond to trends across cars, sports, gaming, and internet culture while supporting broader game and licensing objectives. This is an opportunity to see your creative work reach a large global player audience and directly influence the game’s visual experience. The ideal candidate is a Roblox-native artist who enjoys experimentation, fast-paced production, and turning ideas into polished visuals. Create high-quality renders for both in-game content and marketing materials. Collaborate closely with the Art Lead to solve artistic challenges and deliver assets consistently and on schedule. Bring creative input to asset requests, improving concepts while remaining aligned with game, art direction, and project objectives. Execute artwork according to the established visual style, creative direction, and requirements from licensing partners. Follow established art-production pipelines, processes, documentation, and implementation standards to ensure efficient asset creation. Apply feedback from the Art Lead and other stakeholders to refine assets and ensure they meet quality, artistic, and technical requirements. Experiment with composition, lighting, visual storytelling, and other creative techniques to elevate the quality and impact of game artwork. Stay informed about relevant trends across automotive culture, sports, Roblox, gaming, and online communities to inspire fresh visual concepts. Requirements: 1–3 years of professional experience in a creative field, or equivalent experience through freelance work or personal/independent projects. A strong portfolio featuring several examples of high-quality renders created for Roblox games. Demonstrated creative judgment and the ability to elevate existing assets through thoughtful visual improvements. Proficiency with Blender, Photoshop, Roblox Studio, and Premiere Pro . Strong understanding of composition, lighting, rendering, and visual presentation. Ability to work effectively within established creative direction and production processes while contributing original ideas. Strong collaboration and communication skills, particularly when incorporating feedback and working with creative leads. Ability to work full-time, with a commitment of 40+ hours per week . Must be 18 years of age or older . Nice to have: Familiarity with project-management platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, JIRA, or similar tools. Experience using Moon Animator . Experience creating animations within the Roblox ecosystem. Additional experience with tools such as Maya, GIMP, or Substance Painter. Benefits: Competitive compensation, including above-market salary, profit sharing, and stock options. Flexible paid time off, including vacation and applicable federal or bank holidays. Fully remote, work-from-anywhere environment. Retirement benefits, with company contributions depending on country and eligibility. Medical, dental, and vision coverage, depending on location, with additional insurance benefits available in certain countries. Professional development support, including reimbursement for courses, training materials, and other learning resources. Virtual company-wide gaming events and opportunities for in-person team gatherings. Robux allowances and other gaming-related perks. Opportunity to collaborate with an intern

southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.title: Senior CNC Programmer
southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.description: CNC Programmer — Make the Code Work At Boom Supersonic, we're building Superpower — a 42-megawatt industrial gas turbine that demands some of the most precise CNC programming work in the industry. Our first Superpower prototype is being assembled now and scheduled for first fire this year. The production facility you’ll work in is being built in parallel — so that when the prototype proves out, we're ready to build the first production units without losing a beat. This is a CAM-depth role. You'll work primarily in Hypermill, programming 5-axis simultaneous, mill-turn, and complex 3+2 operations on Superpower components. You'll make deliberate toolpath decisions, verify your work in simulation with rigor, and produce setup documentation that a machinist can run without calling you. You'll work closely with the Applications Engineer — not as an executor but as a collaborator. When the toolpath won't deliver what the process spec intends, you'll say so and propose something that will. When a machinist tells you the program isn't performing on the machine, you'll understand why. We're building the programming function at Boom, which means you'll have real input into how it works — naming conventions, revision control, template structure, tooling libraries. If you like the software side of machining and want to go deep in a CAM system serious about complex geometry, this is the right place. What we're looking for: CNC programming experience with demonstrated CAM system depth — not just button familiarity. Hypermill experience is a strong differentiator. Mastercam, ESPRIT, or NX CAM experience is transferable. 5-axis simultaneous programming experience — or strong reasoning ability about 5-axis geometry for early-career candidates. Ability to read G-code output and identify post issues without running the machine. Documentation discipline — setup sheets that machinists can run without calling for help. What you'll own: CAM programming in Hypermill for Superpower IGT components — 5-axis, mill-turn, 3+2. Simulation verification — systematic review before any program reaches the machine. Setup documentation — complete enough that someone else can run the job. Program revision control — the machine always has the right version. AE collaboration — toolpath feedback that shapes the process spec over time. Compensation The Base Hourly Range for this position is $45/hr - $55/hr. Actual rate will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Boom’s total rewards package for employees. Other rewards may include long-term incentives/equity, a flexible PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits. There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active. ITAR Requirement To conform to U.S. Government aerospace technology export regulations (ITAR and EAR), applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State . Learn more about ITAR here. Boom is an equal opportunity employer, including for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We are building a culture of merit and excellence. Want to build a faster future? Come join Boom.
